title: Not holding reliable connection to g6 on android 9. Readings every 15 min or not at all. Have to constantly restart collector manually.
body:
We have been using xdrip for almost 2 years, worked fine but latelty we have to constantly restart collector to get it to connect to the g6 81Xxx sensor. Status page just stays on either connecting or scanning. Seems it gets stuck there. Anyway to fix this?
Option to restart collector service on missed readings is checked. I can't have it reset bkuetooth as the phone is connected to a rileylink and resetting bluetooth causes it lose rl connection.
Using a sony xperia a2 running android 9.
